Description: Multiple users in Biology and Medical Research departments reporting degraded checkpoint write performance during peak utilization (10:00-16:00). Storage monitoring dashboard shows OST-07 at 86.9% capacity and OST-14 at 83.1% capacity, compared to cluster average of 68.3%. IOR benchmark confirms write throughput to affected OSTs degraded by 33% compared to balanced OSTs. Root cause: large Biology genomics datasets with default stripe_count=1 concentrated on these two OSTs due to MDT hash distribution.
Resolution: Performed manual OST rebalancing using lfs_migrate for 4.2 TB of data from OST-07 and 3.8 TB from OST-14. Updated default stripe settings: stripe_count increased from 4 to 8 for /lustre/scratch, stripe_size changed from 1MB to 4MB for directories exceeding 1TB. Implemented automated OST balance monitoring script (cron every 6 hours) with Prometheus alerting at 15% variance threshold. Biology department users advised to use lfs setstripe -c 8 for new large datasets.
